text:
Jordan (Sales): Hey team — MeridianBank POC asks for SOC 2 excerpt, a pen-test signatory letter, and confirmation we can open a private dataroom for artifacts. Also asking whether Dedicated reserved capacity will affect POC pricing. Can we scope?

Alex Chen: We can share the SOC 2 PDF (redacted) and our standard pen-test attestation template. For the signed letter we need the customer's legal signatory + NDA in place. @Maria can confirm exact fields.

Maria Gomez: Confirmed. We provide: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test attestation template, KMS separation diagram (redacted). Requirements: NDA signed + named signatory (name, title, email). We do NOT share private key material or raw scan data.

Jordan (Sales): Quick billing Q — if they want a 2-week Dedicated trial, does that bump them into reserved billing?

Sam R: Short answer: Hosted usage can run off free credits. Dedicated requires a contract/commit; we can do a short-term trial pool with estimated cost. I'll draft a pricing estimate.

Alex Chen: To provision dataroom, please use the request form: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request — fill customer name, contact, NDA status, and desired TTL. Sample email to send to security@redwood.com:

```
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: Request for Pen Test Attestation & Dataroom
Customer: MeridianBank
Signatory: Jane Doe, CISO, jane.doe@meridianbank.com
NDA: attached
Purpose: POC artifact sharing and SOC2 excerpt
Preferred TTL: 14 days
```

Maria Gomez: Also note: we cannot publish internal IPs or open network ACLs until networking/ops approve. For KMS we can provide custody diagrams and workflow, not the keys.

Jordan (Sales): Customer wants turnaround in 48 hours. Can we manage?

Alex Chen: :+1: We can expedite SOC2 excerpt + pen-test template within 24–48h once NDA and signatory are provided. Dataroom provisioning typically 1 business day after form + NDA.

Security Bot: New ticket created: #INC-2024-512 — dataroom provisioning request queued.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks — I'll request NDA/signatory now and loop in procurement. @Sam R please post the 2-week Dedicated trial estimate when ready.

Sam R: On it, will share ETA ~2h.
